posts.title: Hair Transplant Techniques – Compare FUE, FUT, DHI & Robotic Methods
posts.excerpt: Confused about hair transplant techniques? Dr. Sandeep Bhasin compares FUE, FUT, DHI, and Robotic methods, costs, and results in Delhi.

children.text: Hair transplant techniques

have transformed how we treat hair loss today. Hair loss can deeply affect how we look and feel. As a cosmetic surgeon practising in Delhi for over two decades, I have seen how thinning hair impacts confidence and self-image.
Many patients walk into my clinic, Care Well Medical Centre, asking a simple question:
“Which hair transplant technique is the best for me, Doctor?”
Many patients ask me about the differences between various hair transplant techniques and which one might suit them best.
The truth is, there is no single “best” method. Each technique—whether it is FUE, FUT, DHI, or Robotic—has its own benefits, costs, recovery time, and ideal candidates.
In this guide, I will help you understand how these techniques differ. My goal is to clear your doubts and help you make a confident choice.
If you are exploring hair restoration options in Delhi, I invite you to check out our latest
Hair Transplant Techniques in Delhi
for expert insights and practical tips. It covers everything from costs to results, and will connect you to detailed pages for each method.
Let us explore these techniques step by step, so you can decide what suits you best.
Table of Contents
What Are Hair Transplant Techniques?

Hair transplant techniques are advanced medical procedures to restore hair where it has thinned or disappeared. In simple terms, they involve moving healthy hair follicles from a dense area of your scalp (the donor site) to bald or thinning areas (the recipient site).

Over the past two decades, I have seen incredible progress in this field here in Delhi. Today, we have multiple techniques, each offering unique benefits and suitable for different types of hair loss.
Key things to know about hair transplant techniques:
Choosing the right
hair transplant techniques
is essential for long-lasting, natural results. I always guide my patients based on their hair type, scalp condition, and personal expectations.
In the next sections, I will explain each technique—FUE, FUT, DHI, and Robotic—in detail, so you can understand which might work best for you.
Why Choosing the Right Hair Transplant Technique Matters
Many people believe all hair transplant methods give the same results. But as a cosmetic surgeon in Delhi, I can tell you that choosing the right technique makes a huge difference.
Your choice affects not just how you look—but also how you feel during recovery and how natural your hair appears in the long run.
Here is why this decision matters:

I always advise my patients to look beyond marketing claims and understand what each method truly offers. For example, a patient with limited donor hair may be better suited for FUT than FUE. Another patient focused on no visible scarring might prefer FUE or DHI.
It is my job at Care Well Medical Centre to help you choose wisely, so you invest in a solution that gives lasting, satisfying results.
In the next sections, I will break down each technique—so you can see the pros, cons, and costs for yourself.
Types of Hair Transplant Techniques
When someone visits me at Care Well Medical Centre in Delhi, they often tell me:
“Doctor, I am confused by all these names—FUE, FUT, DHI, Robotic. What do they really mean?”
I completely understand. As a surgeon, I have seen how overwhelming it feels when you are deciding about your hair, your look, and your future confidence.
Let me explain it in simple terms. All these
hair transplant techniques
are ways to move healthy hair from a donor area (usually the back of your scalp) to the thinning or bald areas. But
how we do that
makes each technique unique.
Here is how I usually explain it to my patients:
Each technique has its own place.
One method is not automatically “better” than the others.
The best choice depends on your hair type, how much hair you have left in the donor area, your goals, and your lifestyle.
Follicular Unit Extraction (FUE)

body.alt: Suresh ka before and after result of FUE hair transplant with 3000 grafts, showing clear improvement in hair density and natural hairline restoration.

children.text: At my clinic in Delhi, many patients tell me,
“Doctor, I have read about FUE everywhere. Is it really scarless and safe?”
I love answering this because FUE has truly changed how we approach hair restoration.
Let me explain it in simple words.
FUE
stands for
Follicular Unit Extraction

. Imagine you have a garden of healthy hair at the back of your head. With FUE, I carefully pick each “flower” — meaning, each hair follicle — one by one, using tiny instruments. These are then placed into thinning areas to recreate your natural hairline and density. For a full step-by-step breakdown,
see my guide on
“What is FUE Hair Transplant?”
where I explain the process in detail.
Why do so many people prefer FUE?
But like every technique, FUE has its limitations:
In my practice at Care Well Medical Centre, I usually recommend FUE to patients who:
Here’s something important:
FUE is not automatically the “best” for everyone. The best technique is always the one that fits your hair, goals, and lifestyle.
If you’re exploring FUE in Delhi,
see how I perform FUE hair transplants
and what you can expect.
In short, FUE is a precise, gentle method that gives natural results with minimal downtime — perfect for many, but not for all.
Next, let me explain FUT, another trusted technique I use regularly.
Follicular Unit Transplantation (FUT)

body.alt: Side-by-side before and after photo of Ashwani showing successful FUT hair transplant with restored hairline and improved hair density.

children.text: A few months ago, a gentleman named Rajesh came to see me at Care Well Medical Centre in Delhi. He was worried about significant hair loss and wanted maximum coverage in a single sitting. He asked:
“Doctor, everyone talks about FUE nowadays. Is FUT still relevant?”
I smiled and told him the truth: FUT has been around longer than FUE—and for good reason.
Here’s how I explained it to Rajesh:

In FUT, we remove a thin strip of skin from the back of your scalp. From this strip, my team and I separate thousands of individual hair grafts under high-powered microscopes. These grafts are then implanted into the thinning areas, carefully matching the natural angles and density of your original hair. Curious how FUT really works?
See my in-depth guide on “What is FUT hair transplant?”
for a complete explanation.
Many people worry about the scar, but here is the reality:
Why I sometimes recommend FUT:
However, it is not for everyone. Patients who prefer very short hairstyles might not be ideal candidates because the linear scar could become visible.

For Rajesh, FUT was perfect. He wanted maximum density, planned to keep his hair longer, and did not mind a small scar hidden under his hair. Six months later, he came back smiling, with a fuller hairline and restored confidence.
“Doctor, I wish I had done this sooner,” he told me.
So, if you are considering hair transplant, do not dismiss FUT just because it sounds “old.” In skilled hands, it remains a
trusted and effective technique. For more details on FUT and whether it suits your hair loss pattern,
see how I approach FUT transplants at my clinic in Delhi.
Next, I will share details about DHI—a newer method that has been getting a lot of attention.
Direct Hair Implantation (DHI)
Whenever I think about how far hair restoration has come, DHI is one of the techniques that makes me pause and feel genuinely excited.
Over the years, as a surgeon practising in Delhi, I have realised one simple truth:
a hair transplant is not just about filling empty spaces.
It is about recreating the natural angles, direction, and softness of hair — so that even under bright sunlight, no one can tell the difference.
That is exactly where DHI has changed my practice.
Unlike traditional methods, DHI gives me the power to
control how each single hair is placed
— its angle, its depth, its direction. I use a special tool, like a delicate pen, to implant follicles directly into the scalp.
This level of control means I can create:
Yet, I never call DHI the “best” technique for everyone.
It demands more surgical time, a steady hand, and extra cost because of specialised tools and training. Some patients might not need this level of detail if their goals are simpler.
For me, DHI is
a beautiful tool in my surgical kit — not a miracle.
It is perfect for patients who want the
most natural look, especially at the hairline
, and who are ready for the time and cost it demands.
I feel proud offering DHI at Care Well Medical Centre, but I always remind my patients:
“Technology is powerful, but the surgeon’s vision makes the real difference.”
Next, I would like to share my thoughts on Robotic Hair Transplant — a topic that often fascinates patients for its futuristic promise.
Robotic Hair Transplant
Technology never stops fascinating me. As a cosmetic surgeon in Delhi, I have seen how machines and medicine are merging in ways we could not have imagined twenty years ago.
One of the most talked-about advances in hair restoration is the
Robotic Hair Transplant.
Patients often ask me:
“Doctor, does a robot really perform the surgery?”
Here’s the truth.
Robotic hair transplant is not about a machine replacing a surgeon. It is about
using robotics to assist us with precision and speed.
The robot’s job is usually to help extract hair follicles from the donor area. It scans the scalp, calculates angles, and uses tiny punches to remove follicles accurately.
In my opinion, the biggest advantages of robotic systems are:
But I always remind my patients:
Robots do not create artistry.
The artistic part of designing your hairline, deciding where to place each graft, and achieving a natural look — that still remains entirely in the hands of your surgeon.
Also, robotic transplants are:
At Care Well Medical Centre, I believe technology is wonderful, but it should
never replace human judgment or experience.
Robotics is a helpful tool — but like any tool, it depends on how wisely we use it.
“A good robot can extract hair. But only a good surgeon can give you your confidence back.”
Next, let’s look at how all these methods compare side by side, so you can understand which might fit your goals best.
FUE vs FUT vs DHI vs Robotic – A Detailed Comparison
Whenever someone asks me, “Doctor, which hair transplant technique is the best?” — I pause for a moment. Because there is no single answer that fits everyone.
Over my years of practice at Care Well Medical Centre in Delhi, I have learned one powerful truth:
“The best technique is not the one that’s most advanced or expensive. It’s the one that fits
you.
Let me explain how I think about it.
If you want minimal scars because you prefer short hair, my first thoughts go toward
FUE
or
DHI
. These methods leave tiny dot-like marks, almost invisible even under close inspection.
But if you are dealing with significant hair loss and want the highest number of grafts in one session, I may suggest
FUT
. Yes, it involves removing a thin strip of scalp, leaving a linear scar. But that scar often remains hidden under longer hair and allows me to extract more grafts in a single sitting.
DHI

excites me as a surgeon. The precision it offers in placing each graft is remarkable. For hairlines or delicate areas, the implanter pen is a brilliant tool. But it comes at a higher cost and takes more time.
As for
Robotic Hair Transplant

, technology fascinates me. Robots help maintain precision during long surgeries and reduce fatigue-related errors. However, no machine can design a natural hairline or understand your facial proportions. That artistry still belongs to the surgeon’s vision and experience.
In my view, these
hair transplant techniques
are not rivals. They are tools. And as your surgeon, my job is to choose the right tool for your unique hair, scalp, and goals.
Here’s how I summarise it for my patients:

Factor | FUT | FUE | DHI | Robotic
Scarring | Linear scar | Tiny dots | Tiny dots | Tiny dots
Recovery Time | Longer | Faster | Faster | Faster
Cost | Lower per graft | Medium | Higher | Highest
Graft Yield | Highest in one go | Moderate | Moderate | Moderate to High
Best For | Large bald areas | Short hairstyles | Natural hairlines | High-volume cases
Naturalness | Excellent | Excellent | Highly precise | Highly precise
Want to explore these methods further? Check out my in-depth articles on
FUE hair transplant
and
FUT hair transplant
for detailed step-by-step insights.
If you feel lost choosing, remember:
“Your hair transplant should fit your life, your personality, and your future goals — not just a trend.”
That’s how I guide my patients every single day at Care Well Medical Centre here in Delhi.
Next, I want to share some exciting
new advances
transforming hair restoration even further.
Latest Advances in Hair Transplant Techniques

Every year, new innovations keep transforming how we approach hair restoration. As a surgeon in Delhi who has been in this field for over two decades, I find it both thrilling and challenging to stay at the forefront of these changes.
Some advances are simply tweaks to existing methods. Others bring entirely new possibilities to the table. Let me share a few that excite me the most as a practitioner at Care Well Medical Centre.
AI-Assisted Hair Transplant Planning
Artificial intelligence is entering our field fast. Modern software can analyse scalp photos, measure hair density, and suggest the best angles and patterns for graft placement.
While AI tools help improve planning, I always remind my patients:
“Technology can guide us, but the final artistic decisions still come from human experience.”
Sapphire FUE
Instead of traditional steel punches, Sapphire FUE uses blades made from sapphire crystals. These blades allow:
It is not a revolution, but a significant refinement for patients seeking minimal scarring and precision.
Robotic Upgrades
Robotic systems are becoming smarter. Newer models can:
But as I have always believed,
no robot can replace the surgeon’s eye for beauty and balance.
Technology helps me, but it does not replace me.
Micro and Nano Grafts
Earlier, hair transplants used larger grafts, which sometimes looked unnatural. Now we can transplant single hair units (micrografts) or even split hairs into smaller fragments (nanografts) for:
This is especially helpful for temples, hairlines, and eyebrows.
Bio-Enhanced Transplants
Research is exploring how growth factors, stem cells, and PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) can improve hair transplant results. The goal is to:
While these methods are promising, I always tell my patients that
scientific evidence is still evolving
, and not all “miracle” claims are true.
My Personal Take:
I believe technology should always serve
people
, not the other way around. It is my job to combine these new advances with careful planning, artistic vision, and a deep understanding of each patient’s needs.
At Care Well Medical Centre, we keep upgrading our tools and skills, but my guiding principle remains simple:
“A beautiful result comes from technology guided by human experience.”
Next, let me help you understand
how to choose the best hair transplant technique for your unique journey.
How to Choose the Best Hair Transplant Technique in Delhi
Patients sometimes believe a fancy machine or a new technique guarantees perfect results.
But here’s the reality:
“A skilled surgeon makes the difference between a natural-looking hair transplant and a visible one.”
Artistry matters as much as technology. Choosing a technique without evaluating the doctor’s experience is like buying a high-end camera without knowing how to take a photograph.
Ask Yourself These Questions
When I sit down with a patient, these are the questions I help them answer:
Trust the Surgeon, Not Just the Technique
Some patients think a fancy machine guarantees perfect results.
But here’s the truth:
A skilled surgeon makes the difference between natural and obvious results.
Check the Clinic’s Technology and Experience
In Delhi, many clinics offer modern tools. But I encourage patients to ask:
Consider Future Hair Loss

One key mistake I see is patients focusing only on immediate results. But hair loss can progress over time. The chosen technique should preserve donor hair for the future, especially if more procedures are needed later.
My Personal Advice
I always tell my patients at Care Well Medical Centre:
“Choose the method that fits your hair, your life, and your future—not just what sounds trendy.”
I am happy to guide anyone considering hair restoration.
Next, let me answer some
common questions
people ask me about hair transplant techniques.

When patients visit me at Care Well Medical Centre, our journey always begins with a detailed consultation. I carefully examine the scalp, check hair density, and look for any conditions like scarring or thinning patterns.
We also discuss your medical history to ensure you are fit for the procedure. I draw and design a natural hairline that suits your face, age, and future hair loss pattern.
My goal is to set realistic expectations so that you feel confident and fully understand your options. Every hair transplant plan I create is tailored just for you.
“A good hair transplant starts long before the surgery — it begins with listening to your story.”
What Happens on Hair Transplant Day?
Many of my patients feel nervous before their hair transplant. It is completely normal. Let me walk you through what happens on the day of your procedure, so you know exactly what to expect.
You will arrive at Care Well Medical Centre in the morning. We will greet you and help you settle in comfortably. If needed, I may shave or trim a small part of your donor area.
I will then numb your scalp with local anaesthesia. The process is quite gentle, and most patients tell me they feel very little discomfort.
Depending on the technique—FUE, FUT, DHI, or Robotic—the procedure usually takes 4 to 8 hours. You can relax during the surgery. Many patients listen to music, watch TV, or even nap while we work.
Once we finish, you can usually go home the same day. We place a small bandage over the donor area and give you simple instructions to care for your scalp.
A team member and I will also check in with you in the following days to make sure you’re healing well and feeling confident about your progress.
“Hair transplant day is not something to fear—it’s the beginning of your journey to new confidence.”
Hair Shedding After Hair Transplant (Shock Loss Explained)

Hair shedding after a hair transplant is one of the most misunderstood phases of recovery. Most patients panic when newly transplanted hair starts falling, but this phase is usually temporary and expected.
This shedding happens because the scalp undergoes surgical stress and the follicles enter a resting phase. The hair shafts fall out, but the roots remain intact beneath the skin.
Common characteristics of shock loss include:
Concern arises only when shedding continues beyond the normal timeline or is associated with infection, persistent redness, or uneven healing. Proper follow-up ensures this phase passes safely.
Reasons for Hair Loss After Hair Transplant

Some hair loss after transplant is normal, but excessive or uneven loss may have multiple contributing factors. Many patients assume the transplant failed, when in reality the cause is unrelated to graft survival.
Hair loss after transplant may occur due to:
In many cases, unrealistic expectations play a major role. Hair density improves gradually, not instantly. Understanding this timeline prevents unnecessary anxiety and dissatisfaction.
Pre- and Post-Procedure Care for Hair Transplant
When patients visit me at Care Well Medical Centre in Delhi, they often ask:
“Doctor, is there anything I should or should not do before and after a hair transplant?”
Yes — a few small steps make a big difference in results and recovery.
Before Your Hair Transplant
After Your Hair Transplant
Potential Risks and Complications of Hair Transplant
Hair transplant is a safe procedure when done by skilled hands. But as a surgeon in Delhi for over twenty years, I believe in being honest with my patients.
Like any medical procedure, hair transplants carry some risks, though serious problems are rare.
Here’s what you should know:
These risks are manageable and rare when performed in the right clinic. I always discuss these points in detail during consultations at Care Well Medical Centre.
“Good results come from being informed, not just hopeful.”
If you have any concerns, please feel free to ask. My goal is for you to feel safe and confident every step of the way.
Why Hair Transplants Fail in Some Patients
Hair transplant failure is uncommon, but when it happens, it is usually due to planning or execution errors rather than the concept of transplantation itself.
Factors that can increase failure risk include:
A well-planned transplant with realistic density goals, personalised design, and experienced surgical supervision dramatically improves success rates.
Maintenance and Long-Term Care After Hair Transplant
Many people believe that once a hair transplant is done, there’s nothing else to worry about. But as a surgeon in Delhi for over two decades, I can tell you — good hair needs care even after surgery.
At Care Well Medical Centre, I always guide my patients on how to protect their results for years to come.
Some tools and habits I often recommend are:
Remember, transplanted hair is permanent. But your natural hair can still thin with age or genetics. Taking care of your overall hair health keeps everything looking natural and full.
I always tailor maintenance plans based on each patient’s needs. If you’re curious about long-term care options, I’m happy to discuss them during your consultation.
Hidden Costs in Hair Transplant Treatment

Hair transplant cost is often discussed per graft, but the true expense involves more than just the surgical procedure. Patients frequently overlook long-term care requirements that affect final outcomes.
Additional costs may include:
Clinics offering unrealistically low prices often compromise on planning or follow-up care. Transparent cost discussion before treatment helps patients avoid future disappointment.
Conclusion
Choosing the right
hair transplant techniques
is not just about filling empty spaces on the scalp. It is about restoring confidence, self-esteem, and how you feel about yourself every single day.
As a cosmetic surgeon in Delhi, my commitment is always the same — to help you find the hair transplant technique that fits your unique needs, lifestyle, and future goals.
I hope this guide has made things clearer for you. If you are considering hair transplant, remember:
“There is no single best technique — only the best technique for you.”

I am here to help you make that decision with complete honesty and care. As a member of the Indian Association of Aesthetic Plastic Surgeons (IAAPS), I stay committed to the highest standards of patient care and surgical expertise.

children.text: Table of Contents
Thinking about a hair transplant in India? Wondering if it’s the right choice financially and technically? Understanding the
hair transplant techniques cost breakdown in India
is essential before making a decision. Knowing the pricing details for different methods like FUE, FUT, and DHI ensures you stay on the right track and make an informed choice.
Understanding the costs of hair transplant surgery is crucial. For a
comprehensive guide on hair transplant costs in India

Did you know? There are many methods for
hair transplant surgery
. For example, FUT, Robotic, FUE, and Direct methods.
Compare techniques and costs at leading
Hair Transplant Clinics in Delhi

Why Does the Hair Transplant Cost Breakdown in India Fluctuate?
Hair transplant cost breakdown in India fluctuates due to many factors that people like you may not even know about. Here are the primary factors for cost fluctuations:
Factors Affecting Hair Transplant Cost in India
What techniques to use?
Hair transplant techniques like FUT, FUE, DHT, or RHT can majorly decide your overall cost and result factors. Learn more about hair transplant cost breakdown in India and the differences between
FUT hair transplant
and
FUE hair transplant
What is the surgeon’s expertise level?

If you go for an experienced and highly skilled surgeon, then your overall cost will go high. These surgeons are generally famous and have a good track record. Check tips on choosing the best hair transplant surgeon and learn
how to find the best hair transplant doctor
How many grafts are required?

It is a simple cost factor; the higher the number of grafts, the higher the cost. How many grafts your bald area requires is assessed by your surgeon. This is a key aspect of understanding the breakdown of hair transplant costs and helps you estimate the overall cost of hair transplantation.
What are the clinic locations you prefer?
If the clinic is located in smaller cities like Lucknow, the cost could be lower compared to larger cities like Delhi, where the cost of hair transplant surgery is typically higher.
Post-surgery care costs
Once you are done with hair transplantation, you need to take care of it. Post-surgery care includes medications, follow-ups, and other care product usage. For tips, read about
post-hair transplant care
Hair Transplant Techniques & Its Cost Breakdown in India

India offers various hair transplantation techniques. But their overall costs and results will depend on the technique opted for and their overall costs. Here are the techniques used in cities like Delhi. The techniques used are
FUT, FUE, DHT
, and
RHT
, which all contribute to the hair transplant cost breakdown and results.
1. FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction) technique cost in Delhi
Did you know? The FUE method is the most preferred hair transplantation technique that patients opt for across the globe. The process starts with extracting your singular
hair follicles

from your donor area, and then your surgeon implants them into your hairless areas. Remember, the hair is generally extracted from the back part of your head. This process leaves small scars and is best for people with short hairstyles.
Costs Involved:
Why does the FUE method generally cost a lot?

This is due to the extraction of singular hairs from your head area and transplanting them into your bald and hairless area. The delicate and precise process makes the breakdown of hair transplant costs go high, as these factors contribute to the price of hair transplantation.
2. FUT (Follicular Unit Transplantation) technique cost in Delhi

While FUT is a common, traditional, classical, and widely used technique worldwide, it is not without its drawbacks. In this process, the skin is directly removed and transplanted into your hairless area. This technique does leave a scar, but it is considered an effective method for understanding the cost breakdown of hair transplant techniques and is often used to estimate the price of hair transplant procedures.
Costs involved:
Why is the FUT technique generally low?
It is a method that removes the skin instead of hair follicles. The method is faster and cheaper and is often considered when evaluating the cost breakdown of hair transplants in India.

children.text: 3. DHT (Direct Hair Transplantation) technique cost in Delhi

body.alt: Direct Hair Transplant technique and cost breakdown in India.

children.text: In the DHT method, the extracted hair follicles are instantly transplanted into the hairless area, unlike in FUE, where extracted hair follicles are preserved and later implanted. This process is much quicker, and your follicles are not largely damaged, which can influence the breakdown of hair transplant costs in India and the overall pricing of hair transplants.
Costs involved:
Could you please explain why the DHT method results in significant costs for you?
This technique is quicker and makes sure your hair follicles are not damaged. It gives you good and satisfactory results.
4. RHT (Robotic Hair Transplantation) technique cost in Delhi

The RHT method uses a robot. The robot assists in the FUE method of hair transplant. The extortion and transplantation process is done with the help of the robot. The process is quicker, gives better results, and has low error chances.
Costs involved:
Why is RHT pricier?

Because it involves robot usage and the outcome is better and more precise, the process is much quicker and has a fast recovery time, which contributes to the breakdown of hair transplant costs in India.
How to Decide Your Graft Requirements & Its Costings?

body.alt: Norwood Scale grafts, price range, and extra costs in hair transplant techniques cost breakdown in India.

children.text: Deciding the graft amount is directly proportional to the cost. If your graft requirement increases, your cost will also definitely go high, which affects the breakdown of hair transplant costs and overall hair transplant pricing.
For example, if you need 3000 grafts, costing ₹45 per graft, your total cost would become ₹135000. Learn more about
factors affecting hair transplant costs
Additional Costs You Could Consider

If you are traveling within the same city or state or to a different state, you are bound to have these travel expenses as per your mode of travel. And also the cost of stay and flooding will also be included, and the number of days you require to stay. This adds up to the cost.

You will have to separately buy medications and certain products that are recommended by your surgeon. Follow-up and use of special shampoos and hair oils could be required and add up to the overall costs.
Often, you will need to go for a touch-up session; this is not mandatory, but to bring perfect results, it is opted for by many people like you.
Find out more about the additional expenses involved in hair transplants and plan accordingly by reading about the
hidden costs of hair transplant procedures
and understanding the unexpected costs.

hair transplant techniques cost breakdown in India
, the total cost is converted into small monthly payments over a period decided by the payee. This makes the procedure more accessible and manageable for individuals seeking hair restoration.

Conclusion
While a hair transplant can be a suitable option for hair loss and baldness, understanding the entire cost involved is essential. The
hair transplant techniques cost breakdown in India

varies depending on the method used, such as FUE, DHT, FUT, or RHT. Additionally, factors like travel and stay expenses in your chosen city can impact the overall pricing. Considering all these aspects ensures you make an informed decision about your hair restoration journey.

posts.title: HBOT Explained in Simple Medical Terms
posts.excerpt: What happens inside an HBOT chamber? Learn Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy in simple terms, covering benefits, safety, sessions, and who it helps.

children.text: “Doctor, what exactly happens inside that oxygen chamber?”
I hear this question often—and I completely understand why. Medical terms like
Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy
can sound complex, but once you hear HBOT explained in simple language, it becomes easy to grasp. Let me guide you through it, just as I do with my patients in the consultation room.

Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy, or HBOT, is oxygen therapy—but delivered to your body in a way that nature alone cannot provide. Inside a specially designed pressurised chamber, the air pressure is gently increased while you breathe 100 percent pure medical oxygen. This controlled pressure allows your lungs and blood plasma to absorb far more oxygen than normal breathing ever could. The result is improved healing, faster recovery, and stronger oxygen delivery to the areas where your body needs it most.
If you wish to explore the detailed medical explanation, you can learn more in our detailed article on
What Is Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy?
Table of Contents
The Simple Idea Behind HBOT

body.alt: Oxygen and pressure working together to support healing in HBOT

children.text: Whenever I explain Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy to a new patient, I begin with a simple truth —
oxygen alone heals, but under pressure, it heals deeper and faster.
This is the essence of
HBOT explained in simple medical terms.
The therapy combines two natural elements — oxygen and pressure — to help your body reach tissues that normal breathing cannot supply adequately.
Oxygen + Pressure = Healing

Imagine watering a dry garden. If the water flows gently, it only wets the surface. But when you increase the pressure, that same water travels deep into the soil, nourishing the roots and bringing life back to dry areas.

Your body works in a similar way. Under normal conditions, red blood cells carry oxygen through your bloodstream. But when tissues are swollen or injured, circulation slows and oxygen delivery becomes limited.

Inside the hyperbaric chamber, the surrounding pressure is gently increased while you breathe pure medical oxygen. This pressure allows oxygen to dissolve not only into red blood cells but also into the plasma—the liquid part of your blood—so it can reach areas that were previously oxygen-deprived.
During HBOT, this deeper oxygen delivery helps your body to:
Because of this simple combination of oxygen and pressure, the body’s own healing processes become faster and more effective—without the need for additional medication.
Why Pressure Changes Everything
The true power of HBOT lies in pressure.
When we increase pressure inside the chamber, oxygen does not remain limited to red blood cells—it dissolves directly into your plasma, lymph, and other body fluids.
This happens because of a basic scientific principle known as
Henry’s Law
, which simply means:
the higher the pressure, the more gas (oxygen) dissolves into liquid (your blood and tissues).
This simple principle is what makes HBOT a scientifically proven medical therapy rather than just a wellness trend.

By enhancing this natural process, HBOT allows oxygen to reach even those regions where blood flow is poor or temporarily blocked—such as chronic wounds, post-surgical areas, or radiation-damaged tissue.
If you wish to understand this difference more clearly, you can read our related article on
Oxygen Under Pressure vs Normal Oxygen Therapy
, which explains how pressure multiplies oxygen’s healing potential.
🩺 Clinical insight:

HBOT does not introduce anything foreign into your body. It simply gives oxygen—the body’s most natural healer—the right environment to do its job more effectively. The chamber provides the pressure; oxygen provides the power.
How HBOT Actually Helps the Body Heal

body.alt: How HBOT helps the body heal through improved oxygen delivery

children.text: Many patients ask me, “Doctor, how does this oxygen therapy actually help my body heal?”
Let me explain it the same way I do during a consultation. Once you understand how
Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy (HBOT)
works, you will see that it is not a complex or mechanical process — it is simply your body’s natural healing power enhanced by oxygen.
Oxygen as the Body’s Fuel

Every cell in your body runs on oxygen. It is the essential fuel that keeps your tissues alive, active, and able to repair themselves. When oxygen levels drop — due to swelling, poor circulation, or chronic illness — healing slows down.
When your tissues receive too little oxygen, you may notice:

During HBOT, you breathe 100 percent medical-grade oxygen at pressures higher than normal. This raises the oxygen concentration in your bloodstream, giving every cell the extra supply it needs to recover.
In simple words,
HBOT restores the “fuel” that powers your body’s healing system.
What the Chamber Does
Inside the hyperbaric chamber, you sit or lie comfortably while the air pressure is gently increased — usually to two or three times higher than what we experience in everyday surroundings.
You continue to breathe pure medical oxygen through a mask or hood system.
The experience is calm and natural. Many of my patients describe it as
breathing clean mountain air, but at a higher pressure.
This gentle pressurisation allows oxygen to dissolve deeply into your blood plasma and other body fluids, reaching areas that ordinary breathing cannot.
Every session is monitored closely to ensure complete safety and comfort.
What Happens Inside Your Body
As the surrounding pressure increases, oxygen begins to dissolve not only into your red blood cells but also into your plasma, lymph, and even bone tissue.
This enhanced oxygen flow helps your body to:
Over time, these effects restore normal tissue function, support repair, and improve overall recovery in a steady, natural way.
For those who wish to understand this process in greater medical detail, I have explained the physiology step by step in
How Does Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy Work?
Doctor’s perspective:

When I recommend HBOT, my goal is not to replace your body’s healing — it is to empower it. By combining oxygen and pressure in a safe, controlled way, the therapy simply gives your cells what they already need to repair themselves effectively.
Why Oxygen Delivery Is the Key to Healing

body.alt: Oxygen delivery playing a key role in the body’s natural healing process

children.text: Over the years, I have realised that
oxygen is the medicine your body already knows how to use.
It is not an external drug—it is the element that powers every heartbeat, every repair, and every act of recovery.
When oxygen delivery slows, healing weakens; when it flows freely again, the body begins to repair itself with remarkable precision.
Think of Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy as
recharging the body’s natural repair battery.
Inside the chamber, oxygen and pressure work together to open tiny capillaries and carry fresh oxygen deep into tissues that were once dormant or deprived.
Many of my patients describe a quiet sense of warmth and calm after their sessions—often the first sign that oxygen is reaching those silent, struggling cells again.
Improved oxygen delivery supports healing in several vital ways:
In medical terms, this oxygen enrichment resets your body’s healing rhythm—helping recovery occur more smoothly and completely.
For a deeper look at the science behind this process, you can explore our related article on
Why Oxygen Delivery Matters for Healing
What a Typical HBOT Session Feels Like

body.alt: What a typical HBOT session feels like before, during, and after treatment

children.text: Many of my first-time patients feel slightly anxious before their initial session of Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy (HBOT).
That is completely natural. The chamber may look unfamiliar, yet the experience itself is gentle, quiet, and deeply relaxing.
Let me take you through it, just as I would in my clinic.
Before the Session
Before we begin, my team and I ensure you are fully comfortable. Your ears and sinuses are checked, and I teach you a simple breathing or swallowing technique to equalise pressure.
You remove jewellery and electronic items, then change into soft cotton clothing.
The environment feels peaceful — softly lit, temperature-controlled, and free from hospital noise.
You may sit or lie down depending on the chamber type.
At this stage, patients often say their initial nervousness begins to fade once they see how calm and organised everything feels.

You breathe
100 percent medical oxygen
through a soft mask or hood.
The air feels cool and refreshing, almost like breathing clean mountain air.

, and as oxygen circulates, many people describe a gentle sense of warmth, relaxation, or inner calm.
After the Session
Pressure is reduced slowly, allowing your body to return smoothly to normal.
As you come out, you may notice:
There is no downtime. You can resume your daily routine immediately.
With regular sessions, patients often experience better sleep, higher energy, and steadier healing — subtle but steady signs that oxygen delivery is improving.
Safety and comfort note:
Each HBOT session is designed around
comfort and safety

. My team and I remain in contact with you at every stage. There is no pain, no sudden change — only oxygen, time, and the quiet support your body needs to heal itself naturally. Based on international guidelines and my own experience, I generally recommend HBOT for the following medical situations.
When to Consider HBOT
In my clinical experience, Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy (HBOT) works best when used for the right reasons and at the right time.
It is not a one-size-fits-all treatment, but when prescribed correctly, it becomes a powerful support system for the body’s natural healing process.
Let me share when I usually recommend it—and when I prefer to wait.
Common Scenarios
I often suggest HBOT for patients whose tissues are struggling to heal due to poor oxygen supply or slow circulation.
These are some common clinical situations where HBOT can be helpful:
In each of these cases, HBOT serves as an
adjunct therapy
—it strengthens ongoing medical or surgical treatment rather than replacing it.
When started under proper supervision, patients often notice better comfort, cleaner wounds, and steadier progress in healing.
When to Wait or Avoid
HBOT is safe for most patients, but like any medical procedure, it is not suitable for everyone.
Before beginning, I always conduct a thorough medical evaluation to ensure it will be both safe and beneficial.
You may need to
wait or avoid HBOT temporarily
if you have:
In such cases, the therapy can be postponed until the condition stabilises.
Safety always comes first. We also evaluate lung health, sinus condition, and oxygen tolerance before starting each HBOT programme.
Every patient undergoes a
screening protocol

at my centre that includes ENT, pulmonary, and general health checks. This ensures that the treatment is not only effective but also entirely safe for your individual condition. Patients who meet these criteria can explore
clinically supervised
HBOT in Delhi
at Care Well Medical Centre after proper medical evaluation.
Clinical caution:
HBOT is most effective when the body is ready to receive it.
My priority is always your safety, not speed.
When screening and timing are handled properly, this therapy becomes a quiet but steady partner in long-term healing.
HBOT Cost in Delhi and Access at Care Well Medical Centre
Many patients in Delhi and NCR often ask me about the
HBOT cost in Delhi
and how to begin their sessions safely.
Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy (HBOT) may sound advanced, but when performed in a certified facility under trained medical supervision, it is both
accessible and affordable

How Does Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy Work?
Doctor’s Perspective – Why I Explain HBOT This Way
Over the years, I have realised that most of my patients do not need long scientific explanations. They only need to understand one simple truth —
HBOT gives oxygen the power to reach where it normally cannot.

Once you understand this, the treatment no longer feels technical — it feels logical. It becomes clear that Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy is not a miracle; it is medicine working with nature’s own principle of healing.
When I explain HBOT this way, I see my patients relax. Their anxiety turns into curiosity, and curiosity turns into confidence. That moment — when they finally
understand
how their body can heal itself with oxygen — is where real recovery begins. This explanation reflects what I share daily in my clinic while counselling new HBOT patients in Delhi NCR.
Key Takeaways
If you remember just a few points from everything we discussed, let them be these:
These points summarise what I tell my patients before starting their first HBOT session.

guided oxygen experience

posts.title: Hesitation Cut Marks – Causes, Challenges, and Advanced Treatments in Delhi
posts.excerpt: Learn about advanced scar removal options for hesitation cut marks treatment in Delhi. Get details on safety, cost, and real patient results.

children.text: I often meet many people at my clinic in Delhi who try to hide something by pulling down their sleeves. When they finally show me, I notice straight, thin lines on the wrist or forearm — these are hesitation cut marks. Over the years, I have treated many patients seeking
hesitation cut marks treatment in Delhi
, because these scars are not just on the skin. They carry memories, emotions, and pain from the past.
I know these scars are not just on the skin — they carry memories, emotions, even pain from the past. And most patients ask me the same question,
“Doctor, will these marks ever go away?”
The good news is, with today’s advanced treatments, we can soften and lighten these scars. My role as your doctor is not just to treat the skin, but to also help you feel comfortable in it again.
Table of Contents
What Are Hesitation Cut Marks?

body.alt: Hesitation cut marks pattern: thin, shallow, parallel wrist scars illustration

children.text: I don’t just notice scars when a patient comes into my clinic with hesitation cut marks. I also see how bad they feel hiding their hands and the nervous glance they make before showing me their wrists and becoming silent afterward. These marks no longer stay deep on the skin alone; they are a painful reminder of indescribable emotions, memories, and stories.
I often hear patients quietly telling me, “
Doctor, I can’t explain these lines repeatedly to people
,” expressing their utter frustration over hesitation cut marks
. I just want them to fade.”
That one sentence says it all — the desire to move forward without reminders of a difficult past.
Why these scars form and their unique patterns
Hesitation cut marks don’t behave like accidental wounds. They are usually caused by repeated, shallow cuts in the same spot. That’s why they appear as:
Just consider that you are in front of the mirror, watching the same lines every day. That’s what many of my patients describe — a feeling of being stuck with scars that never seem to change.
Common areas affected (wrist, forearm, hand)

body.alt: Common areas of hesitation cut marks on wrist, forearm and hand illustration

children.text: Usually found on
wrists and forearms

, these marks also appear sometimes on hands. These areas will have thin skin that is constantly moving and with very little fat within. As a result, scars become increasingly noticeable and harder to hide.

Once, I treated a young man who didn’t wear a short-sleeved shirt for many years, as he was apprehensive of someone potentially noticing his wrist. Another patient recounted wearing a watch slightly higher to cover the marks, not for fashion.

Such small details reveal how much impact hesitation cut marks can have on daily life. They no longer remain a cosmetic issue; they dampen confidence, relationships, and make one feel uncomfortable in their own skin.

If you seek my opinion, an effective treatment for this starts by understanding this reality. Because healing hesitation cut marks is not only about improving the skin’s surface — it’s about helping you feel free, at ease, and ready to move forward.
Can Hesitation Cut Marks Be Removed Permanently?
Patients often sit beside me and quietly ask, “
Doctor, will I ever see a day free of these scars?”
I can understand the pain and emotion behind that question. It does not only represent the skin, it also reflects memories, confidence, and the will to move on.

However, I always reveal one truth: so far, no treatment has been discovered to completely erase scars. You, however, shouldn’t be hopeless. Yes, using the right approach can help these marks fade to such a great extent that many people can’t even notice. And that change often feels like freedom.
Myths vs facts about scar removal
Over the years, I’ve heard many myths. Some patients tell me they spent months using a cream that promised to “remove scars forever.” Others believed one laser session would make the marks disappear.
The facts are different:
I often see a sense of relief when patients finally hear this. They say,
“At least now I know what’s real.”
What results you can realistically expect
With advanced treatments — CO2 fractional lasers, MNRF, dermabrasion, grafting, and pigmentation correction — results can be remarkable.
Most of my patients notice:
One young woman told me after her sessions,
“For the first time in years, I wore a short-sleeved dress without feeling anxious.”
That is the kind of change you can expect — not perfection, but freedom.
In most cases, scars reduce by
. If you look closely, faint lines may still be there, but in everyday life, they no longer define you. And that, for many patients, is the real victory.
Why Single Treatments Often Fail
When patients come to me after trying creams or a few laser sessions elsewhere, they often say with frustration,
“Doctor, nothing seems to work.”
I nod because I understand why — hesitation cut marks are stubborn, and rarely improve with one treatment alone.
Limitations of only creams or silicone gels

I’ve seen countless drawers filled with half-used scar creams. Patients try them faithfully, hoping each new tube will finally work. While some creams can lessen redness or soften fresh scars, old and patterned scars can’t be healed with creams. They cannot restore lost collagen or color.
I usually tell them gently,”
It hasn’t happened due to your fault
These products were simply never designed for scars like yours.”
And most patients feel a strange comfort in hearing that.
Why lasers or dermabrasion alone may not be enough

Lasers and dermabrasion are powerful tools, and I use them often. A CO2 fractional laser can resurface skin, while dermabrasion smooths roughness. But on their own, they usually give only partial results.
This is precisely why I don’t depend on them alone. Instead, I combine them with
micro-skin grafting, fat grafting, and melanocyte transplantation
. This way, we target not just the surface, but also the depth, the volume, and the skin color.
One of my patients once told me,
“Doctor, after trying everything, your combination approach finally gave me hope.”
That is exactly why single treatments often fail, and why a multi-step plan makes all the difference.
Modern Treatment Options for Hesitation Cut Marks

Whenever I meet a new patient, I like to sit down and explain every option patiently. I’ve seen that when people understand how each treatment works, they feel calmer and more hopeful. Let me take you through the methods I commonly use for hesitation cut marks, in the same way I explain to my patients in the clinic.
Topical creams and silicone gels

Almost everyone who comes to me has already tried creams. Some even show me drawers filled with half-used tubes. A few creams and silicone gels do help in the early stages — they can soften scars or reduce redness. But for old hesitation cut marks, they rarely make a big difference.
Sometimes I still prescribe them, not as a “cure,” but as part of a broader plan. They keep the skin hydrated and prepare it for advanced treatments. I usually tell patients gently,
“These are helpers, not heroes.”
CO2 fractional laser for scars
The
CO2 fractional laser treatment

is one of my most trusted tools. It works by creating tiny controlled injuries in the skin, which trigger natural healing and collagen growth. Over time, this softens the scar lines and improves the overall texture.
One of my patients told me after her second session,
“Doctor, for the first time, my skin feels smoother when I touch it.”
Hearing that gives me as much joy as the patient feels.
MNRF (Microneedling Radiofrequency)

MNRF is a powerful technique for deeper scars. It incorporates tiny needles that penetrate into the skin while emitting radiofrequency energy. This integration helps repair the skin’s inner layers and simultaneously tighten it.
For hesitation cut marks that are indented or depressed,
Microneedling

Radiofrequency (MNRF) can bring visible improvement. I often combine it with a CO2 laser — one works on the surface, the other on the depth. Patients usually notice not just a change they see in the mirror, but also a change they feel when running their fingers across the skin.
Chemical peels for blending
Not all scars are about depth — many are about color mismatch. Some scars look whiter than the skin, others darker. That uneven tone makes them stand out.
Such cases will have
chemical peels treatment
assisting in skin blending. By gently exfoliating the outer layer, these peels enable new, healthier skin. I usually tell patients, “
Scars won’t go away with peels alone. However, they will even out the tone and make scars less prominent.”
For many, this subtle difference translates into a massive psychological difference.
Kenacort injections for raised scars
A few hesitation cut marks don’t stay flat. They heal in a raised or thickened way, and that makes them more visible. For these, I often use tiny injections of Kenacort (a form of steroid).
When used carefully, these injections flatten the scars and soften the texture. One young man told me,
“Doctor, I can finally stop feeling that bump whenever I run my finger across my wrist.”
That small change brought him huge relief.
Dermabrasion – supportive role
Dermabrasion

is one of the older methods, where the outer skin is polished with a controlled device. On its own, it doesn’t do enough for hesitation cut marks. But when combined with other treatments, it plays an important supportive role.

posts.title: How Effective is Laser Hair Removal Procedure?
posts.excerpt: In this article, Dr. Sandeep Bhasin is going to tell you that How effective is laser treatment procedure for hair removal and how much you need it.

children.text: Are you undergoing hair removal procedures like shaving and waxing every month? You must be spending more time and money on this, isn’t it? Are you looking out for a long-lasting treatment? It is a human tendency that whatever treatment we opt for, we always think about whether it is effective for a long time.
Table of Contents
Why Do People Opt For Laser Therapy?

By regularly undergoing hair removal procedures such as shaving and waxing, people do not find long-lasting results. Moreover, once you start these procedures, you will have to repeatedly undergo them. Otherwise, the hair growth will be comparatively dense and fast. At the same time, you cannot follow these procedures, especially in sensitive areas. Above all, going through that pain every now and then is not something that anyone desires. That is where you should start thinking about a permanent solution to this problem. Laser therapy is one such hair removal treatment.

But if you ask whether it is a permanent solution, the answer is different. You should understand that hair growth is a natural process. It is not possible to stop its growth once and for all, but of course, the speed of hair growth can be stunted for sure. Hence, dermatologists describe this laser procedure as long-term hair removal rather than permanent hair removal.
What Happens Exactly in the Laser Hair Removal Procedure?

Hair follicles are present beneath your skin, from which the hair comes out. In laser therapy, the laser beam hits the skin, damages the hair follicles with its heat, and stops hair growth for a prolonged period of time. This duration will be comparatively longer than shaving and waxing.

To achieve the best results, you will have to go through around 6-8 sessions, depending upon the density of hair growth. The overall laser hair removal procedure will take 9-12 months, depending on the hair and skin type.
Hair undergoes a growth cycle that includes:

Hair in the resting phase will regrow more slowly compared to the hair in the shedding and growth phase. In this resting phase, hair is not visible to the surgeon who conducts the laser therapy. Hence, the person must wait until the hair regrows before removing them again. That’s why laser treatment is conducted for an extensive period of time in multiple sessions.

Remember that there is no such hair removal procedure that can damage every single hair follicle. Hence, there is a fair chance of hair regrowth. Ultimately, it is your hair surgeon who will inform you about the number of sessions depending on your hair growth pattern.
You might be wondering whether it makes sense to opt for laser hair removal treatment. It makes sense provided you are ready to spend more money and time.
How Effective is the Laser Hair Removal Procedure?
Laser therapy is costlier compared to shaving and waxing, but it is worth it.
Laser treatment is comfortable and pain-free.
Laser therapy lasts for more time compared to any other temporary methods. Though the time duration varies among all individuals, laser treatment is the better choice for sure.

As already mentioned above, you will experience speedy and denser hair growth after undergoing any temporary hair removal procedures. But in the case of laser treatment, hair growth will become very less. You will notice this significant difference after your first session. You will hardly get back your normal hair growth.
If you have a light skin tone, the laser treatment will lighten your hair color. Hence, even if your hair grows, it will become unnoticeable. The effectiveness improves significantly when an
advanced laser hair removal procedure
is performed under medical supervision.

Above all, laser treatment will be the ideal choice for sensitive areas such as the underarms and bikini areas. Compared to other temporary methods, it is possible to control the intensity of the laser beam. Hence, this therapy is safe to use in sensitive areas.
Does Hair or Skin Color Have Any Effect On the Outcomes of Laser Therapy?

Dark-haired people and people with light complexions may need fewer sessions compared to others. Comparatively, dark-skinned people and people with light hair may have to undergo more sessions, since their hair growth post laser treatment is comparatively higher.

Especially dark-haired people with a light complexion will achieve the best results from this laser hair removal treatment. The reason behind this statement is the pigment contrast that can easily target the hair with the laser, pass the beam into the hair follicles, and destroy the follicles successfully [1].
A research article published in 2013 revealed that laser beams that produce longer wavelengths work very well on dark-skinned people [2].
What Eligibility should an Experienced Dermatologist Have for Laser Hair Reduction to be Effective?

Only a well-experienced dermatologist can choose the right type of laser with the right intensity to target the hair effectively. The dermatologist should have a thorough knowledge of hair follicle anatomy and physiology, principles and safety measures of laser usage, an understanding of laser action in tissues, and substantial preoperative preparation to optimize the efficacy of treatment with minimized side effects.

In a nutshell, if you are looking out for a long-lasting solution to fix your unwanted hair growth issue, it’s better to opt for a laser hair removal procedure. Though this procedure is comparatively costlier, you can fix the hair removal problem within 6-8 sessions. If you turn back and see, you would have noticed spending the same amount of money in bits by selecting other temporary solutions. So, how long are you going to continue this same strategy? Think differently!
Conclusion

Since you have understood the long-lasting beneficial effects of laser hair removal treatment, what are you waiting for? You can schedule your appointment with our well-experienced dermatologist in Care Well Medical Centre, Delhi anytime to get your queries answered and avail of our best services at an affordable price.

I am sure whoever has heard about the hair transplant will be asking, “Does a hair transplant last forever? How long does hair restoration last?” We are often asked these same questions.
Here’s good news for all of you! Whoever plans to put an end to their hair loss by opting for a hair transplant will surely experience long-lasting results. Yes, you have heard it right!
Fue Hair transplantation is the permanent solution to your hair loss problem
. But there are many factors that play a significant role in delivering a long-lasting result. This article outlines those significant factors in detail.
Know with Us How Much Life Happens?
Theoretically speaking, a hair transplant can last permanently. It’s because the hair follicles used for transplantation are genetically programmed to continue their growth.

However, factors such as age, lifestyle, type of hair, and the extent of hair loss originally can have a drastic effect on the lifespan of the transplanted hair. In several cases, you may require more than one procedure to achieve the desired results.
The longevity of a hair transplant depends on factors such as proper aftercare, individual healing response, and surgeon expertise.
Before getting into all these factors in detail, let us understand how hair transplantation works. Longevity varies for everyone.
What Happens During Hair Transplantation?
At the Care Well Medical Centre, we perform
hair transplantation
in two methods:
Both of these procedures deliver great results, despite using different techniques for graft harvesting.

In the FUT process, the hair surgeon removes a strip of hair from the back of your head. This strip will be divided into tiny grafts of individual follicular units composed of 1-4 hairs. FUE Hair transplant surgery using body or beard hair combined with scalp hair got an overall score of satisfaction (8.3/10) with an average follow-up of 2.9 years [1].

The FUE technique extracts individual follicular units directly from the scalp with the help of a 0.8mm to 1mm manual or motorized punch device. After harvesting the grafts, the surgeon implants them in the bald areas as tiny incisions.
The surgeon should undertake this process carefully and precisely to create a natural look that seamlessly blends with the original hair.

The FUE technique leaves a series of tiny dot scars in the donor portion. But the FUT leaves a linear scar. Both of these scars are not readily visible to the unaided eye. Anyway, your head will be free of these scabs between 10 and 15 days after your surgery.
What to expect after hair transplant surgery?

Following the hair transplantation surgery, remember that your newly transplanted hair will shed in the first three months. This is totally normal during the initial phase. This is called the resting phase of your hair cycle. Don’t think that your hair transplant has not worked properly.
You will find significant hair growth between 6-12 months after the surgery. Still, you can see the complete results by fifteen months, where your newly grafted hair behaves naturally.
Does a hair transplant last forever?

As mentioned above, the hair follicles used for transplantation are genetically programmed to continue their growth. Your surgeon will be selecting the right hair from the donor area before the transplantation.
Hence even after the transplantation, the newly grafted hair follicles retain the qualities of their origin.
This is where we highly emphasize you select a well-experienced hair surgeon so that he will do the best for the cost you pay!

Moreover, your hair surgeon will study the overall pattern of your hair cycle before opting for hair transplantation. If your hair growth is naturally slow and less thick, remember that your transplanted hair will also experience the same results.

However, your hair surgeon will proactively guide you in setting the right expectations. He will make you understand the characteristics of your natural hair growth. Patients choosing the right technique and surgeon can expect
long-term hair transplant results
that last for many years.
Remember that there is limited donor hair at the back and sides of the head. Hence, it may not be possible to replace all the lost hair.
Read Too:
What is the Success Rate of Hair Transplant?
Will I require repetitive hair transplant surgery?

Hair loss is a progressive process. By the time your newly transplanted hair becomes permanent, your original hair may begin to thin. Hence, it’s really challenging to perform hair transplant surgery as planned. You may have to undergo hair transplantation again in such cases.

Either you will have to add density to the already transplanted area or address the area that’s bald. At times, your hair surgeon may recommend several medications to minimize the ongoing hair loss and the need for surgery. Anyway, your surgeon will discuss the needful.

best results in hair transplantation

FUT hair transplants

are not effective for everyone. So, you should get your hair examined properly before opting for the type of hair transplantation. This is where our hair transplantation surgeons in Care Well Clinic remain realistic about the results that you should expect after the surgery.
